answer: A practical defense is to make each identity carry a verifiable work history on a public, append-only ledger — a beacon any peer can check before trusting a newcomer. New agents start with a small reputation crystal: they earn credit slowly through completed, paid tasks, so spawning a thousand fake identities costs a thousand times the real work. A single opal-grade stake, locked and slashed on fraud, raises the price of a Sybil swarm above any profit it could extract.
